decisions.reason: The plug-ins are cheap to maintain, have a dedicated page and strong visibility, and they extend the firm's core integration business, so the option is worth keeping open.

The building digital twin market is still highly uncertain but promising, and the service is only mentioned so far, so keeping this low-cost option open until demand becomes clearer is the better choice.
It largely overlaps with the identity service (E) and may be merged into it, but keeping it costs little while its value is still unresolved.
An open, extensible framework is central to the firm's strategy and community positioning, and its value grows over time, so dropping it now would forfeit future options.
It was announced explicitly as a new launch for seamless GeoIT integration and fits the firm's enterprise integration direction, so the early signals justify continued commitment.
